name: psychopenhars
description: psychopenhars.com: WordPress 7.1 + Twenty Twenty-Five child theme, migration scripts.

scripts.start: cp -f server/htaccess.example local/.htaccess 2>/dev/null || true; wp-env start && bash bin/after-start.sh
scripts.reset: wp-env reset development && wp-env start && bash bin/after-start.sh
scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/psy-repo/local/seed.php
scripts.sync-htaccess: rm -f local/.htaccess && cp server/htaccess.example local/.htaccess && docker restart $(docker ps -qf name=psychopenhars.*wordpress-1)
